scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,yellow" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
